items.event: Nitto ATP Finals final, Turin: Carlos Alcaraz vs Zverev or Medvedev
items.line: Alcaraz came from a set down to beat Shelton 3-6, 6-3, 7-6(1) and reach his second straight Turin final, on a 13-match winning streak. He plays the winner of Zverev vs Medvedev, a semi that started around 04:30 JST and may be live now. Alcaraz is chasing his first year-end title.

items.event: The RSM Classic (PGA Tour finale), Sea Island: Round 3
items.line: Rain washed out Saturday. Neergaard-Petersen, Thorbjornsen and Penge share the lead at -9, with six players one shot back and Koepka in the pack. Round 3 is Sunday and the final round Monday, with PGA Tour cards on the line in the season's last event.

items.event: Premier League: Liverpool vs Manchester United (Anfield)
items.line: This is Mauricio Pochettino's first match in charge of a United side that sits 18th with one league win. A win could lift them out of the drop zone. Liverpool are 4th but have taken just five points from five home games.

items.event: Davis Cup Final 8, Bologna: quarterfinals begin
items.line: The knockout week opens with Czechia vs Canada. Hosts Italy face Korea on Wednesday and Great Britain play Germany on Thursday. The final is Sun Nov 29.
